theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_c1c_immersion_local_injOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (x : Euclid m), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G x) → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Set.InjOn G (Metric.closedBall x r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x r, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G z)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
